summary: Bragg Gaming Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing a non-brokered private placement of up to 751,445 subscription receipts at US$1.73 each, raising ~$1.3M. Each receipt converts into one common share and one warrant exercisable at US$2.16 for 36 months. The offering is contingent on closing of the company's acquisition of Drayton International. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Subject to a four-month Canadian hold and U.S. Rule 144 restrictions. Insiders and Drayton's Matt Davey are participating. Watch for closing of the underlying acquisition and any warrant acceleration trigger.
